description: Production against a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint, reached by repointing a live model profile with BASETEN_BASE_URL: the endpoint's host must not be a Baseten host, the store is Postgres via DATABASE_URL, and the endpoint's key must be present in the environment. Dual control is required: review acceptance and model promotion (including rollback) each complete only on two recorded decisions by different actors, neither of them the actor who created the object being decided. Naming this profile binds these rules — a configuration that violates one refuses at startup, by name, before anything serves.
label: Hosted, self-served endpoint — the production shape off Baseten's hosts
name: hosted-self
